label: Minus L
note: Omira, Ireland and Germany; UHT, 1.5 % fat, 0.1 g lactose per 100 g

about.text: Lactose-free UHT milk of the Omira dairy group in Ravensburg, Germany, introduced in 2001 and still sold as MinusL. The classic 1.5 % fat version holds under 0.1 g lactose per 100 g, down from about 4.5 %, because the lactose is split by lactase.

links.name: Dairy Industries International: Milk aimed at the lactose intolerant (24 Sep 2001)

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Lactase splits the milk sugar into glucose and galactose; the milk is UHT-treated and packed.
